sets.title: Quick Quiz
sets.description: Choose the correct prepositional form in each sentence

items.prompt: Мы живём в _____. (We live in a village.)
items.explanation: Location: в + prepositional. Деревня → в деревне (-я → -е).

items.prompt: Она думает о _____. (She's thinking about the exam.)
items.explanation: Думать о + prepositional: экзамен → об экзамене.

items.prompt: Концерт будет в _____. (The concert will be in March.)
items.promptEnglish: The concert will be in March.
items.explanation: Time (months): в + prepositional. Март → в марте.

items.prompt: Дети учатся в _____. (The children study at school.)
items.explanation: Location: в + prepositional. Школа → в школе.

items.prompt: Он работает на _____. (He works at the post office.)
items.promptEnglish: He works at the post office.
items.explanation: На почте (at the post office) uses на, not в. Почта → почте.

items.prompt: Мы читали об _____ фильме. (We read about this movie.)
items.explanation: Об (before vowel) + prepositional: этот → об этом.

items.prompt: Встреча на _____ неделе. (The meeting is this week.)
items.explanation: Time: на этой неделе. Эта → этой (feminine prepositional).

minimalPairs.context: Она идёт в _____. (She's going TO the library.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Direction uses в + accusative: библиотека → в библиотеку.

minimalPairs.context: Она сидит в _____. (She's sitting IN the library.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Location uses в + prepositional: библиотека → в библиотеке.

minimalPairs.context: Он едет на _____. (He's going TO the station.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Direction uses на + accusative: на вокзал.

minimalPairs.context: Он ждёт на _____. (He's waiting AT the station.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Location uses на + prepositional: вокзал → на вокзале.

blanks: Я был в _____ вчера. (I was at the museum yesterday.)
Мы говорили о _____. (We talked about the weather.)
Она родилась в _____. (She was born in June.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Location, topic, and time in prepositional case

sets.title: В or На?
sets.description: Choose the correct preposition for each location
sets.descriptionRussian: Выберите правильный предлог для каждого места

categorySorting.instruction: Sort: В or На for these locations?

errorCorrection.explanation: На заводе, not в заводе. Factory is a fixed expression with на.
В Москве, not на Москве. Cities always use в.

errorCorrection.hint: A book lies ON the table, not inside it.
errorCorrection.explanation: На столе (on the table). В столе means literally inside the table (like in a drawer).

errorCorrection.hint: Theater is an enclosed building: в.
errorCorrection.explanation: В театре, not на театре. Enclosed venues use в.

items.prompt: Студенты сидят _____ лекции. (The students are sitting in a lecture.)
items.promptEnglish: The students are in a lecture.
items.explanation: На лекции (at a lecture). Events use на + prepositional.

items.prompt: Мы отдыхаем _____ даче. (We're relaxing at the dacha.)
items.explanation: На даче (at the dacha). Fixed expression with на.

items.prompt: Он живёт _____ квартире. (He lives in an apartment.)
items.hint: Apartment is an enclosed space: в.
items.explanation: В квартире (in an apartment). Enclosed living spaces use в.

sets.title: Tricky Endings
sets.description: Practice irregular and special prepositional endings

patternRecognition.sentence: в лесу, на полу, в шкафу, на берегу
patternRecognition.question: What is unusual about these prepositional forms?
options: They use the special -у ending instead of the regular -е
patternRecognition.answer: They use the special -у ending instead of the regular -е
patternRecognition.explanation: Some masculine nouns have a special locative form ending in -у: лес → в лесу, пол → на полу, шкаф → в шкафу, берег → на берегу.

patternRecognition.sentence: о любви, о ночи, в тетради
patternRecognition.question: Why do these end in -и instead of -е?
options: Feminine nouns ending in -ь take -и in prepositional
patternRecognition.answer: Feminine nouns ending in -ь take -и in prepositional
patternRecognition.explanation: Feminine -ь nouns: любовь → о любви, ночь → о ночи, тетрадь → в тетради.

items.prompt: Мы гуляли в _____. (We walked in the forest.)
items.hint: Лес has a special locative form.
items.explanation: В лесу (special -у ending for location). This is one of the irregular locative forms.

items.prompt: Она написала в _____. (She wrote in her notebook.)
Мы сидим на _____. (We're sitting on the floor.)
items.hint: Пол has a special locative form.
items.explanation: На полу (special -у ending for location). Another irregular locative.

minimalPairs.context: Мы говорили о _____. (We talked about the forest.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: We talked about the forest. (topic, not location)
minimalPairs.explanation: О + topic uses the regular -е form: о лесе. The special -у form is only for physical location: в лесу.

minimalPairs.context: Я думаю о _____. (I'm thinking about love.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Feminine -ь noun: любовь → о любви (-и ending). Любве does not exist.

blanks: Одежда висит в _____. (The clothes are hanging in the wardrobe.)
Мы отдыхали на _____. (We rested on the shore.)
Она мечтает о _____. (She dreams about life in Paris.)
Ключи лежат на _____. (The keys are lying on the shelf.)
hints: Шкаф has special locative: в шкафу.
Берег has special locative: на берегу.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All prepositional case uses in one final round
sets.descriptionRussian: Все конструкции с предложным падежом в финальном раунде

items.prompt: Я много знаю о _____ стране. (I know a lot about this country.)
items.promptEnglish: I know a lot about this country.
items.explanation: О + prepositional. Feminine adjective/pronoun: эта → этой.

items.prompt: Фильм начинается _____ восемь часов. (The movie starts at eight.)
items.promptEnglish: The movie starts at eight o'clock.
items.hint: В + time for 'at' a specific hour.
items.explanation: В восемь часов (at eight o'clock). В + accusative for specific times.

items.prompt: Они живут на _____ этаже. (They live on the fifth floor.)
items.promptEnglish: They live on the fifth floor.
items.explanation: На пятом этаже. На + prepositional. Masculine adjective: пятый → пятом.

errorCorrection.hint: В + prepositional for location, not nominative.
errorCorrection.explanation: В + prepositional: город → в городе. The adjective should also be prepositional: большом.
На + prepositional: стадион → на стадионе. Nominative is for the subject.

errorCorrection.hint: Neuter nouns ending in -ие take -ии in prepositional.
errorCorrection.explanation: Nouns ending in -ие: путешествие → о путешествии (double -и). This is a spelling pattern, not irregular.

translation.hint: о + prepositional for topic. Музыка → музыке
в + prepositional for months. Апрель → апреле
